w:r.w:t: CA Firm Management & Secure Document Workflow System
This document defines the functional and non-functional requirements for a web-based system designed to streamline operations of a Chartered Accountant (CA) firm.
The system will provide a centralized platform for:
Task assignment and execution by staff
Final approval and monitoring by CA
Centralized dashboard for complete firm control
Work item generated from client request
Payment request generated after task approval
that replaces manual and fragmented workflows such as:
structured, secure, and automated workflow system
Automatic task creation from client requests
Allows clients to request services and upload documents.
Handles lifecycle of tasks from creation to completion.
Provides complete visibility and control to CA.
View all tasks, clients, documents, and invoices
Ensures quality control through CA approval.
Handles secure storage and organization of documents.
Documents linked to client and task
Invoice generated by CA after approval
Documents visible but locked before payment
Manual reminder sending by CA and Staff
Advanced features may be added later
The system will be deployed on secure cloud infrastructure to ensure scalability, security, and reliability.
Initial deployment may use optimized resources
Backup and monitoring will be implemented
